examples.ar: تَفَتَّحَتْ زَهْرَةُ اليَاسَمِينِ مَعَ خُيُوطِ الفَجْرِ الأُولَى.
examples.en: The jasmine flower bloomed with the first threads of dawn.

examples.ar: الزَّمَنُ كَفِيلٌ بِشِفَاءِ الجُرُوحِ وَمَحْوِ الآلَامِ.
examples.en: Time is capable of healing wounds and erasing pains.

examples.ar: تُعَدُّ زِيَارَةُ المَرِيضِ مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ الَّتِي تُقَرِّبُ بَيْنَ القُلُوبِ.
examples.en: Visiting the sick is considered one of the deeds that bring hearts closer.

examples.ar: زِرَاعَةُ القَمْحِ تُسْهِمُ فِي الأَمْنِ الغِذَائِيِّ لِلْبَلَدِ.
examples.en: Wheat cultivation contributes to the food security of the country.
And say, 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge.'

examples.ar: تَمَيَّزَ الحَكِيمُ بِزُهْدِهِ فِي زَخَارِفِ الدُّنْيَا الفَانِيَةِ.
examples.en: The wise man was distinguished by his asceticism in the decorations of the mortal world.
